title: AI Engineering Hub
summary: A large multi-project hub of AI engineering tutorials and agent applications; one subproject, sdv-mcp, is an MCP server tool that loads tabular data, builds SDV metadata, and generates synthetic relational data on demand. SDV's multi-table HMASynthesizer is run to fit and sample synthetic data, exposed as an agent-invocable tool.
evidence: sdv-mcp/tools.py:29-33: synthesizer = HMASynthesizer(metadata); synthesizer.fit(data); synthetic_data = synthesizer.sample(scale=1)
needs: sdv-mcp is one small tool within a large unrelated tutorial hub; overall repo importance to SDV is limited to this subdirectory.
